Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified aphids as herbivores that feed on producers but misinterpreted the terminology, equating trophic level 2 with “second-level consumer.” In standard usage, herbivores are primary (first-level) consumers, while second-level consumers are predators of herbivores. This conceptual mix-up led to selecting D instead of the correct C, and the task was prematurely marked complete without verification.
